overview: After 1.c4 Nf6 White plays 2.e4, offering the e4 pawn to Black's knight with ...Nxe4. White hopes for a big centre with d3 and rapid development, but Black keeps an extra pawn. I am unsure of the details and of what the main line is.

white_ideas.idea: Regain the pawn with Qa4+ or Nc3
Quick development and central play with d3
Exploit the knight's exposed position on e4

black_ideas.idea: Take with ...Nxe4 and hold the pawn

typical_structures.structure: Open centre, White a pawn down with a development lead

character.notes: Gambit with open play and risk.

gambit.notes: e4 pawn can be taken by ...Nxe4.

approach.notes: Almost never seen at strong level.

level.notes: Speculative and dubious, not for beginners.

character.reason: A gambit with open play and unclear compensation.

gambit.reason: White offers e4 and Black can keep it with ...Nxe4.

soundness.reason: Probably gives White little for the pawn against accurate play.

approach.reason: Strong players seldom play an early 2.e4 gambit like this.

plans.reason: White gives a pawn for time.
